newPlatforms.country: United States / Caribbean-focused media network with global digital radio, app and editorial reach.

newPlatforms.notes: Passively verified on 2026-07-19 from Reggae Vibe Media's official media-submission, live-radio, current editorial and terms pages. The form accepts a direct audio upload up to 268.44 MB and shows a visible 'If you are human, leave this field blank' honeypot. Published guidance requests high-resolution MP3 320 kbps or WAV, prefers clean radio edits, requires properly tagged artist/title/production-credit metadata and encourages a short biography plus promotional photo. Selected submissions may receive 24/7 global airplay, DJ consideration, editorial/social coverage and app placement. The generic site Terms contain broad ownership/use language for 'Submissions'; because the music-upload page is a specifically requested submission route, the exact interaction between those provisions and uploaded masters requires legal review before use. thereggaevibe@gmail.com is first-party published and syntactically valid but is a free-mail general contact rather than the canonical form. Current activity is evidenced by a live 24/7 programme schedule and editorial posts dated 9 and 15 July 2026. No field, file, honeypot, checkbox, account, payment or submission was used.

newPlatforms.notes: Passively verified on 2026-07-19 from Crags Radio's official submission, contact, schedule, about and privacy pages. A presenter reviews submissions and may notify the artist if a show will play the track. The current schedule includes Unsigned Sessions, dance, house, electronic, chillout and globally oriented programming. The station streams 24/7 and reports a new Studio 2 podcast facility opening in July 2026; the site also published news on 16 July 2026. studio@cragsradio.co.uk and info@cragsradio.co.uk are first-party published, syntactically valid and domain-aligned general contacts, not authorized replacements for the form. No field, file, checkbox, email, CAPTCHA, payment or submission was used.
